result.code:
# part_size_mb is the size of each multipart chunk, in megabytes (default 5)
client.files.upload(file_path="dataset.csv", part_size_mb=5)
result.facts: part_size_mb is an int parameter of client.files.upload (default 5, not required) that sets the size of each multipart chunk when uploading large files, in megabytes. The sources give no minimum value. One chunk also says multipart mode activates automatically above part_size_mb, which seems to conflict with the separate max_file_size_mb limit of 25 MB, so that behaviour should be checked.
